title: Review P4
summary: An independent read-only review checks P4.1–P4.8 against the amended release gate and knowledge/p4-execution and records a GREEN or RED verdict with findings in artifacts/reviews/P4-review.md.
why: Owner requested a review of P4 (M17, D27). The freeze is the last point where a weak rule is cheap: a fresh reader catches comparator rules that let a break through (try one unlisted break per category), a release graph a tag can bypass, fixes that silently changed a frozen format, evidence from a different sha than C, and 0.x leftovers.

include: Gate: every gate.md row against its evidence (sha = C or C+1, CI URLs resolve, logs exist)
Comparator: rule table vs code; for each category one break not in the unit catalogue tried in a throwaway clone (as the drill does) — reported, not committed
Release graph: release.yml needs/uses, no continue-on-error, label via env, tags fetched; guard test cases
Fixes: every commit since the P3 exit touching packages/** is in fixes.md with a demonstrating check; no frozen identity changed without the owner
Tests: no weakened/skipped/deleted assertions (git diff of tests/ since the P3 exit commit ebf36ad2)
D24/D25 cleanliness (P4.1 V2 pattern), relocation.md and load.md plausibility
Verdict, findings table {id, item, file:line, rule, severity, fix}
exclude: Changing code, fixtures or plan items (read-only)
Re-designing the reference or the gate

reads.why: Rules every P4 item follows: demonstrated fixes only, stop rule for frozen contracts, 1.0 starting point, owner WIP, pushes, long runs, evidence
Exact commands, PHP 8.4 shim, driver ports, composer update rule, CI evidence procedure
The amended release conditions and which evidence this item contributes

rules: A finding needs a file:line and the violated rule; style preferences are not findings.

validation.cmd: git diff --quiet HEAD -- packages tests bin docs .github compatibility.json composer.json
validation.expect: exit 0 (the review changed nothing outside the plan)

result.notes: Review P4: Verdict GREEN after corrections (reviewed candidate C=3d789538 RED on R1). R1 medium: ContractWorld::rowCounts on Laravel 11 x PostgreSQL counted every schema (F2 fallback) - fixed in 2360df2b (ContractWorld + ContractKitRegressionTest, fixes.md F10), checked by php -l and pint only. R2 low: CompatibilityTest names v0.3.0/v0.7.0 as D26 requires but conventions item 3 / P4.1 V2 do not list it as an exception - plan amendment for the owner. Gate evidence, comparator (20 unlisted in-memory breaks, all rejected), release graph, fixes, tests diff since ebf36ad2, D24/D25, relocation and load checked: no other finding. The fix is after the freeze: owner decides between moving C (CI-PUSH, new pointer) and tagging C+1 with the fix in 1.0.1.
deviations: Owner: 'прогоны не делай', 'только ревью и исправление кода и тесты': the review fixed R1 in packages/** and tests/** instead of staying read-only; no test/drill/qualification run (comparator breaks probed in memory instead of a throwaway clone). V2 evaluated with the owner WIP paths excluded by pathspec; the unfiltered diff hash equals the session-start hash.
